project_type: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite SPA with Express dev server and Vercel serverless functions
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run lint` (tsc --noEmit) to ensure TypeScript strict mode passes. 2. Run `npm run test` to execute vitest tests. 3. Manually test features in browser at http://localhost:5173 with dev server running.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None - no snapshot testing or committed build artifacts
environment_constraints: - Never expose GROQ_API_KEY, OPENROUTE_API_KEY, or SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY to client bundle (only VITE_ prefixed vars allowed). - Database migrations must be run manually in Supabase SQL Editor. - Dev API server runs on :3001, frontend on :5173. - Supabase RLS policies enforce user isolation.
contribution_requirements: - Keep existing light design system, types, and component structure (no UI redesign). - TypeScript strict mode must pass after every change. - Add or update tests for every logic change. - Make small, reviewable changes. - Never use alert(), use toast notifications from ToastContext. - Auth gates required for features needing user data.
key_patterns: - Services in src/services/ export object with methods (e.g., savedTripsService.getAll()). - Utilities in src/utils/ export pure functions. - Database tables use UUID primary keys and RLS policies. - Toast notifications via useToast() hook. - Auth state via useAuth() from AuthContext. - All dates stored as ISO strings. - Cost calculations use multipliers based on destination cost tier.
directory_structure: src/components/ - React components; src/services/ - API service layers; src/utils/ - Business logic and pure functions; src/contexts/ - React contexts (Auth, Toast); src/data/ - Static data (destinations); src/lib/ - Third-party integrations; migrations/ - Supabase SQL migrations; api/ - Vercel serverless functions
